title: Soft Ontology Priors over Latent Concept Posteriors for Weakly Supervised Neuro-Symbolic Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) predictors that supervise only the task label suffer from reasoning shortcuts: distinct concept mappings achieve the same maximum likelihood, leaving the recovered concepts unidentifiable and unsafe for downstream reuse. We attack this failure by injecting a soft ontology prior over the latent concepts into the training objective and compiling it together with the task constraint into a smooth, decomposable probabilistic circuit. Under independent Bernoulli perception, the normalisers of the resulting structured concept posterior reduce to weighted model counts that are linear in the compiled circuit size, because the neural leaf weights fold into the circuit before evaluation. translated_title: 面向弱监督神经符号学习的潜在概念后验软本体先验方法
translated_abstract: 仅监督任务标签的神经符号预测器存在推理捷径问题：不同的概念映射可以达到相同的最大似然，导致恢复出的概念不可辨识，对下游复用而言是不安全的。为攻克这一失效模式，我们在训练目标中注入关于潜在概念的软本体先验，并将其与任务约束一起编译为平滑、可分解的概率电路。在独立伯努利感知的假设下，所得结构化概念后验的归一化因子可化简为加权模型计数，其计算复杂度与编译后电路的规模呈线性关系，因为神经叶子权重会在求值之前被折叠进电路中。该软编译策略将专家公理置于电路的权重之中而非其支撑集之中（由数据生成过程所保证的任务结构公理仍保持硬约束），因此带噪声的专家公理只会重新分配先验概率质量，而不会……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将潜在概念的软本体先验注入弱监督神经符号学习的训练目标，并与任务约束一起软编译为概率电路，从而消除推理捷径、使概念可辨识、对噪声专家公理具有鲁棒性，同时实现与编译电路规模呈线性关系的推理复杂度。
en_tdlr: The paper injects soft ontology priors over latent concepts into weakly supervised neuro-symbolic learning and softly compiles them with task constraints into a probabilistic circuit, eliminating reasoning shortcuts, enabling identifiable concepts with robustness to noisy expert axioms, and achieving inference linear in the compiled circuit size.
